moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- Two-segment mix that partially offsets each other — in FY26 revenue was higher in Hospitality while profitability was higher in Auto
- Long operating history: the Company is presenting its 107th Annual Report
- Stable industrial relations and a small, long-standing workforce (51 permanent employees as on March 31, 2026)
- Internal control systems management describes as commensurate with the size and nature of business, reviewed periodically

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Management states both the Auto Division and the Hospitality Division fall in the luxury segment and are not basic necessities, so any reduction in customers' disposable income — through inflation or otherwise — is a threat to the business.
- The MD&A says inflation shall remain a cause of concern in the current financial year due to the global situation and increasing oil prices, and that profitability will continue to be a concern with high operational costs.
- Motor Services (Auto Division) and Restaurant (Hospitality Division) are stated to have huge staff turnover; staff retention is named a major concern, and the Company runs with only 51 permanent employees, so departures are material to service delivery.
- Explicitly named among the major concerns for both industries — both are largely fixed operating costs in a service business, so cost inflation flows straight to margin.
- The MD&A states the Automobile and Hospitality industries are prone to impact from fluctuations in the economy, change in market conditions and competition in the industry.
- Regulations are listed among the factors to which both industries are exposed; the cautionary statement further names Government Policy as a reason actual results may vary materially.
- Customer and guest satisfaction is named a major concern for both divisions — in a service business, reputation and repeat custom are the revenue base.
- The Company has only two reportable segments, both consumer-discretionary and both India-facing; the Directors' Report states there is no research & development activity and no import of technology or foreign exchange earnings or outgo, so there is no offsetting export or innovation base.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Pursue cost reduction across both the Auto and Hospitality divisions to defend profitability against high operational costs and inflation
- Grow revenue in both divisions by adding new customers
- Give additional attention to talent search, training and development of human resources on a long-term basis, in response to high staff turnover in motor services and restaurants
- Continue periodic review and incremental upgrading of internal control systems
- Continue departmental efforts to reduce energy consumption through optimum utilisation of electrical equipment
